comment: Limits for tests/perf/run-resource-audit.py on the router emulator: processes (execs) and file operations on USB (opt_ops) per run; daemons per minute at one DNS query per second (a short window sees more first-time names, which are logged). Measured values of 0.2.0-rc.2 (resource contour: shell builtins, one clock read, lighter admission) plus headroom (daemons vary with the names seen in the window).
